body.name: Gaussian primitive score-correlation family
body.construction: Fix the canonical coordinates \(U\) on \(\mathcal S\). For every \(m\in[n]\), compute \(\Theta_m=\Sigma_m^{-1}\) and \(\Delta_m=\Theta_0-\Theta_m\). Gaussian score algebra on the induced law \(P_m\) gives \(s_m(y)=-\Theta_my\), \(d_m(y)=\Delta_my\), and \(R_m=\mathbb E_{P_0}[d_m(Y^{(0)})d_m(Y^{(0)})^{\top}]=\Delta_m\Sigma_0\Delta_m\); for \(M\subseteq[n]\), set \(R(M)=\sum_{m\in M}R_m\).
